pytest_postgres_compat.note: An earlier attempt in this session ran the FULL unscoped suite with DATABASE_URL pointed at the same container and saw 42 unrelated failures (auth, project_manager, script_generator, prompt_preview, plus 4 in test_execution_attempt_repository.py). Re-running just that one repository test file alone against the same Postgres instance passed 17/17, and re-running with the CI-exact `-m "uses_db and not sqlite_only"` filter passed 947/947 with zero failures anywhere, including the concurrency test. Conclusion: the 42-failure run was cross-test interference from running thousands of unrelated non-uses_db tests against a shared Postgres container under xdist, not a real regression; it is not counted as evidence either way and CI does not run that unscoped command against Postgres.
